mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) depresses consumer and business confidence, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment is high (UNRATE > 4.5%) and the federal funds rate is low (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%), it indicates a liquidity trap where monetary policy is ineffective, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% AND FEDFUNDS < 4.0%

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.5%), economic weakness reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%

mechanism_narrative: A low housing starts rate (HOUST) indicates weak consumer demand and business investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of periods when HOUST < 1300

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017 base), it signals a contraction in real economic output, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of periods when INDPRO < 100

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) is below 160,000 and industrial production (INDPRO) is below 102, it indicates rapid deterioration in labor market and industrial output, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of periods when PAYEMS < 160000 AND INDPRO < 102

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 4.5%
